nodes.label: AI Technology Tree Animation Sequence (Frames 164-240)
nodes.description: An animated sequence showing a stylized digital tree with glowing blue circuit-like roots and a canopy filled with technology icons and UI elements. Frames progress to reveal labeled technology nodes including AI, React, Next.js, GSAP, Node.js, SharePoint, SPFx, PowerApps, Power BI, Dynamics 365, Microsoft 365, and Apple ecosystem logos. Generated by Veo. Represents the growth and interconnection of modern web, AI, and enterprise technologies.
